chapters.label: The FA Cup final
chapters.text: Wembley, 2025, the FA Cup final. Crystal Palace break against Manchester City. Daniel Muñoz races down the right and crosses. Eberechi Eze volleys it in! Palace win the Cup!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: Eze loves to dribble, too. This is how he does it. He runs at the defender, dips a shoulder... and glides away!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. His shoulder drops left. The defender leans that way. Eze pushes the ball right, and he is gone!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn! Drop your shoulder to fake one way, then go the other.
